options: $p \left(x + \pi\right) \nep  \left(x\right)$ for at least one but finitely many $x$
questions.solution:
Given, for $x \in R$

$f\left(x\right) = | sinx |$

$g\left(x\right) = {∫}_{0}^{x}f\left(t\right)dt$, and $p\left(x\right) = g\left(x\right) - \dfrac{2}{\pi}x$

$∵ p\left(x + \pi\right) = g\left(x + \pi\right) - \dfrac{2}{\pi}\left(x + \pi\right)$

$= {∫}_{0}^{x + \pi} | sin\left(t\right) | dt - \dfrac{2}{\pi}x - 2$

$= {∫}_{0}^{\pi} | sint | dt + {∫}_{\pi}^{\pi + x} | sint | dt - \dfrac{2}{\pi}x - 2$

$= 2{∫}_{0}^{\pi2}sintdt + {∫}_{0}^{x} | sint | dt - \dfrac{2}{\pi}x - 2$

[$∵ | sint |$ is periodic function having period $\pi$]

$= 2{\left[- cost\right]}_{0}^{\sqrt{2}} + g\left(x\right) - \dfrac{2}{\pi}x - 2$

$= 2\left(0 - \left(- 1\right)\right) + g\left(x\right) - \dfrac{2}{\pi}x - 2$

$= 2 + g\left(x\right) - \dfrac{2}{\pi}x - 2 = g\left(x\right) - \dfrac{2}{\pi}x = p\left(x\right)$

$p\left(x + \pi\right) = p\left(x\right)$ for all $x$.
